## 🐛 Fixed

- **Percentage text unreadable on a Finished download's progress bar.** `FlatDarkLaf.json` set JDownloader's own `colorfor*` keys but never touched FlatLaf's `ProgressBar.selectionForeground` (the color painted over the filled portion of the bar). Left at FlatLaf's own default, it was too light to read against the near-white fill JD paints once a download completes - the "100%" label was barely visible. Fixed by setting `ProgressBar.selectionForeground` directly to the same `#161616` used everywhere else in this theme; JD's theme loader passes raw FlatLaf keys through, not just its own named set. (#9)
